summary: Neutron Holdings (Lime) filed an 8-K reporting entry into a new $200M senior secured revolving credit facility with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent. No amounts were drawn at signing. The facility is secured by substantially all assets and contains financial covenants: maximum total net leverage ratio of 3.25x and minimum fixed charge coverage ratio of 1.25x, measured quarterly from September 30, 2026. Interest rates float based on SOFR or base rate with margins tied to leverage. The filing is a routine refinancing/credit arrangement, not a special situation transaction.
